about: A Shiba Inu sits on a plain white background, body slightly hunched and head turned to the side, with a mild, sheepish, slightly uncomfortable expression. This dog is Cheems, the ironic cousin of the original Doge. In memes Cheems usually speaks in a broken style that adds extra m sounds to words, as in "cheemsburger", and he plays the meek, unlucky everyman. Captions put him in situations that are a little sad, awkward or doomed, often with a tone of cheerful denial that things will be fine.
origin: The dog's real name was Balltze, a Shiba Inu from Hong Kong whose owner posted photos on Instagram from 2017. Images of him became a fixture of the /r/dogelore subreddit, where the Cheems name and speaking style took off. Balltze died in 2023.
usage:
The top box sets up the situation and the bottom box completes it, often with Cheems' false optimism or a tiny defeat. Classic Cheems captions add an extra m to a word or two ("I amm fimne", "cheemsburger"), which immediately signals the character.

It works for small personal disasters: going to bed at 4am, promising yourself one more game, a diet that ends at the first snack, or an assignment you will "definitely" start tomorrow. Keep both lines short and low-key; Cheems is never dramatic.
ideas: it's a good time to sleep
nothing will go wrong after this
